About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband. Though she always kept a smile on her face, inside she was restless, and she wanted to make Anabil Chilha’s wealth her own together with her brother. After Odity entered the family as Aditya’s beloved, Kalyani realized her dream would not be fulfilled. She began to suffer mental anguish. And One day, after many conspiracies she was able to thrown Odity out of the house. This incident increased the conflict between the two brothers. 

   Odity is now unable to return to the orphanage house because Anabil Chaliha made the land his own at the same time. The people of the ashram now misunderstood Odity because Odity is now Anabil Chaliha's daughter-in-law.  

   After the incident, Odity and Aditya left the house, and their mother tried hard to bring them back because of her love for her youngest son but without success. Meanwhile, Anabil Chaliha became an enemy to Odity. One day, he conspired together with a doctor from the same hospital to defame her and able fired her from her job. The slander was serious enough for her to get a job in a private nursing home also. Aditya mother helped them from time to time, but that was not enough. They both began their struggling lives. Despite being a doctor and the son of a wealthy businessman in the city, they continued their struggling lives by opening a small food stall on the sidewalk.

   After a long legal battle, one day she got her job back. A few days later, Anabil Chaliha suffered from a serious illness and Odity healed him. By then, Anabil chaliha and his wife slowly began to learn about Kalyani’s conspiracies. One day, they learn that kalyani is planning to kill Nibedan, so they throw her out of the house. They welcomed Aditya and Odity after realizing their mistake and eventually returned the land of the ashram. There is also a smile on the faces of the people of the ashram. A happy ending.

description:
BYD's Flood Mode Sparks Discussion in India as Experts Call for Smarter Safety Features

China's electric vehicle giant BYD is attracting attention in India after its advanced Emergency Floating Mode gained renewed interest during recent flood-related discussions. The feature, available on the company's premium Yangwang U8 SUV, is designed to help occupants survive accidental flooding by allowing the vehicle to float temporarily and move slowly through water in emergency situations. As several Indian cities continue to experience severe monsoon flooding every year, the technology has sparked debate over whether Indian automakers should focus more on flood-resilient safety features.

The Emergency Floating Mode is not intended for regular driving on water. Instead, it activates automatically when sensors detect that the vehicle has entered water deeper than its safe wading limit. Once activated, the SUV seals its windows, raises its suspension, opens the sunroof as an emergency exit, shuts down its petrol engine and uses its four electric motors to slowly propel the vehicle at around 3 km/h for up to 30 minutes, helping occupants reach safety during flash floods.

The technology has generated considerable discussion among Indian automobile enthusiasts because cities such as Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and Gurugram regularly witness waterlogging during heavy monsoon rains. Many experts believe that while a floating car may not be practical for mass-market vehicles, Indian manufacturers could adopt several ideas from BYD, including improved battery waterproofing, enhanced electronic sealing, higher water-wading capability, smarter flood detection systems and emergency escape features. These improvements could significantly improve passenger safety during sudden urban flooding.

Automobile experts also caution that BYD's floating mode is strictly an emergency survival feature and should never encourage drivers to deliberately enter flooded roads. The company itself advises owners to use the system only during unexpected flood situations, after which the vehicle must undergo a complete inspection at an authorised service centre.

As climate change increases the frequency of extreme rainfall across many parts of the world, the discussion is gradually shifting from vehicle performance to passenger survival. While Indian manufacturers are investing heavily in electric mobility and advanced driver-assistance systems, many industry observers believe flood-specific safety technologies could become an equally important area of innovation in the years ahead.

title: Commonwealth Games 2026: Glasgowमें बरसे मेडल, Neeraj-Yashvir का धमाका, Judo में बैक-टू-बैक 2 GOLD!
description:
कॉमनवेल्थ गेम्स 2026 के नौवें दिन भारत ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए कुल 6 पदक जीतकर इतिहास रच दिया। जूडो में अस्मिता डे और हर्ष सिंह ने स्वर्ण पदक जीतकर देश का गौरव बढ़ाया, जबकि यामिनी मौर्य ने रजत पदक अपने नाम किया। बॉक्सिंग में भारत के सभी 10 मुक्केबाज सेमीफाइनल जीतकर फाइनल में पहुंच गए, जिससे गोल्ड मेडल की उम्मीदें और बढ़ गई हैं। एथलेटिक्स में तेजस्विन शंकर ने डेकाथलॉन में कांस्य जीतकर नया इतिहास बनाया। वहीं जैवलिन थ्रो में नीरज चोपड़ा ने रजत और यशवीर सिंह ने शानदार वापसी करते हुए कांस्य पदक जीता। नौवें दिन के अंत तक भारत के खाते में 5 गोल्ड, 12 सिल्वर और 6 ब्रॉन्ज समेत कुल 23 पदक हो चुके हैं। अब सभी की नजर दसवें दिन पर है, जहां भारतीय बॉक्सर्स गोल्ड जीतकर पदक तालिका में भारत की स्थिति और मजबूत करने उतरेंगे।

On Day 9 of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, India delivered a historic performance by winning a total of six medals. In judo, Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh clinched gold medals, bringing glory to the nation, while Yamini Maurya secured a silver. In boxing, all 10 Indian boxers advanced to the finals after winning their semifinal bouts, significantly boosting India's gold medal hopes. In athletics, Tejaswin Shankar created history by winning a bronze medal in the decathlon. Meanwhile, in the javelin throw, Neeraj Chopra claimed the silver medal, while Yashveer Singh made a remarkable comeback to secure bronze. At the end of Day 9, India has a total of 23 medals, including 5 gold, 12 silver, and 6 bronze.

title: Breaking News of my Cancer Test to my Husband. Bohot Gussa hua
description:
In this vlog, neetu opens up about her stressful journey dealing with severe hair loss (alopecia) over the past few years. Fearing that the hair loss might be a symptom of an underlying serious illness like cancer, she decides to get a scalp biopsy.
The video documents her day, starting with a family outing for cookies, followed by a relaxing pedicure and hair spa at a salon. After a disappointing lunch where she finds a hair in her Ramen, she heads to her doctor's appointment to discuss her hair loss and hormones (DHT). Later, she enjoys a better meal with her mom before heading home to share her biopsy results with her partner, Lakhan. To her relief, the results turn out to be normal, and Lakhan reassures her, emphasizing that she needs to stop overthinking and focus on improving her gut health instead.

[00:00] Opening up about her fears: The creator gets emotional as she explains her struggle with severe hair loss over the years and her fear that it could be cancer.
[01:07] Morning Outing: Trying Ben's Cookies at DLF Greater Noida and driving around in the rain.
[02:11] Relaxing at the Salon: Getting a pedicure and a hair spa to de-stress.
[03:42] Lunch Disappointment: Ordering Ramen with the group, but ending up frustrated and leaving early after finding a hair in her food.
[06:27] Doctor's Consultation: Discussing her hair loss condition (alopecia) with the doctor, who explains how DHT and hormones are affecting her scalp.
[07:37] Visiting Mom: Heading to her mother's house and dealing with a minor car parking incident.
[09:42] Explaining the Biopsy: Explaining to the viewers why she decided to get the scalp biopsy and how much money and pain she has already endured for hair treatments.
[11:14] Finally Eating Ramen: Taking her mom out and successfully satisfying her craving for Ramen and Dimsums.
[14:08] Revealing the Test Results: Showing the biopsy reports to Lakhan. He scolds her for unnecessarily changing doctors and overthinking, reassuring her that her reports are completely normal and that she just needs to focus on her gut health.Don't forget to share your thoughts/suggestions in the COMMENTS section.

title: Kanha ne Hadd paar kardi.. Lakhan ka Passport Jala diya Gusse mei
description:
Morning Visitors & Trip Prep: The vlog starts with a visit from Rinku Vlogs. The family discusses an upcoming international trip, and they mention that Divya Didi is going on her first international trip. They initially plan to celebrate her birthday before the flight, but plans change because Poonam Didi isn't feeling well.
Feeding Strays: Lakhan also takes some time out to feed a stray dog named Bhola and talks about the stray animal situation in Greater Noida.
The Passport Prank: The main highlight of the vlog is a revenge prank planned by Neetu and Kanha (Gopal). Because Lakhan previously pranked Neetu by pretending she wasn't going on a trip, they decide to get back at him. They take a fake "playbook" passport that looks identical to a real one and set it on fire outside the room.
Lakhan's Reaction: When Lakhan arrives and sees his "passport" burned, he gets completely furious. He scolds the kids and Abhishek, pointing out that destroying a passport is a serious offense (destroying government property) and that their trip is now canceled.
The Reveal: Eventually, they reveal that it was just a fake toy passport and part of a prank. Lakhan admits he had a slight suspicion it was a prank because the cameras were rolling, but he still scolds them for playing with fire, warning the kids that it's dangerous.
Funny Ending: The video ends on a hilarious note where Kanha tries to explain what lessons he learned (about not touching the security guard's belongings kept on the ground), but his phrasing makes it sound like a double meaning, leaving Lakhan and Neetu laughing out loud.

Tamil Nadu Weighs Weekly Chicken Biryani in School Meals, Proposal Awaits CM Vijay's Approval

A proposal to serve chicken biryani once a week in government schools is under consideration by the Tamil Nadu government, drawing nationwide attention and sparking debate over nutrition, cost and implementation. The proposal has been submitted to Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, with officials saying no final decision has been taken yet.

The idea was put forward by Tamil Nadu's School Education Minister Rajmohan, who said every major government in the state's history has strengthened the school meal programme in its own way. He noted that K. Kamaraj introduced the Mid-Day Meal Scheme, M. Karunanidhi added eggs, M.G. Ramachandran expanded it into the Nutritious Meal Programme, and J. Jayalalithaa further increased egg distribution. Rajmohan said he hopes to continue that legacy by introducing chicken biryani once a week for students in government schools.

According to officials, the proposal aims to improve nutrition while also making school meals more appealing to children. Supporters believe a more nutritious and attractive menu could help improve attendance and encourage students to remain in school. However, questions have also been raised about the financial implications, procurement of ingredients, food safety standards and whether the programme can be implemented uniformly across thousands of government schools.

Tamil Nadu has long been regarded as a pioneer in school nutrition programmes, with its noon-meal scheme often serving as a model for other states. Any change to the menu is therefore likely to attract attention beyond the state. Officials have clarified that the proposal is still being examined and that Chief Minister Vijay will take the final decision after reviewing all aspects of the plan.

The proposal has already generated widespread discussion on social media, with some welcoming it as a progressive nutrition initiative while others questioning its practicality and cost. Until the government announces its final decision, chicken biryani remains only a proposal and has not yet been added to the school meal programme.

description:

The discharge of 61,600 cusecs of water from the Ujani Dam into the Bhima River has led to a rise in the river's water level at Pandharpur. As a result, Bhakt Pundalik Temple and several other temples located in the Chandrabhaga (Bhima) riverbed have been surrounded by water. The administration remains on alert and has initiated precautionary measures in view of the potential flood situation.

title: இலங்கையில் கனமழை;  பெருக்கெடுத்து ஓடும் ஆறுகள்
description:
இலங்கையின் பல பகுதிகளில் பெய்து வரும் கடும் மழையுடனான வானிலை காரணமாக, மக்களின் இயல்பு வாழ்க்கை பெரிதும் பாதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. 

குறிப்பாக மலையக பகுதிகளில் தொடர்ச்சியாக பெய்துவரும் கடும் மழையினால் ஆறுகள் பெருக்கெடுத்துள்ளதுடன், ஆற்று நீர் தாழ்நிலப் பகுதிகளிலுள்ள நகரங்கள் மற்றும் கிராமங்களுக்குள் பிரவேசித்துள்ளது. 

நுவரெலியா, கண்டி, இரத்தினபுரி, கேகாலை உள்ளிட்ட பல பகுதிகளில் தொடர்ச்சியாக கடும் மழை பெய்து வருகின்றது. இதனால், மகாவலி, களுகங்கை ஆகிய ஆறுகளின் நீர் மட்டம் வெகுவாக அதிகரித்துள்ளதை அவதானிக்க முடிகின்றது. 

இதேவேளை, கண்டி, நுவரெலியா, கேகாலை ஆகிய நகரங்களுக்கு மண்சரிவு சிவப்பு அபாய எச்சரிக்கையும் இரத்தினபுரி மாவட்டத்திற்குள் மண்சரிவு அபாய எச்சரிக்கையும் விடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

Gulab Jamun | गुलाबजाम 🌹
description:
Ingredients | साहित्य:

200 gms Mawa/Khoya | मावा / खवा 
3 tbsp Maida | मैदा
⅛ tsp Baking Powder | बेकिंग पावडर
2 tsp Milk (or as required) | दूध (गरजेनुसार)
Ghee for frying | तूप
Sugar Syrup | पाक
1½ cups Sugar | साखर
1½ cups Water | पाणी
½ tsp Cardamom Powder | वेलची पूड
A few Saffron Strands | केशर
½–1 tsp Rose Water | गुलाबजल

Method|कृती:

Boil the sugar and water until the sugar completely dissolves. Add the cardamom powder, saffron, rose water and dried rose petals, then switch off the heat. Keep the sugar syrup warm. In an electric chopper, add the mawa/khoya, maida and baking powder and pulse twice. If the mixture feels dry or doesn't come together, add 1 tsp milk and pulse twice again. Add another 1 tsp only if needed. Transfer the mixture to a plate and knead gently for 1–2 minutes until you get a soft, smooth dough. Do not over-knead. Cover and let it rest for 10 minutes.Divide into equal, smooth, crack-free balls and fry on low to medium-low heat for 8–10 minutes until evenly golden brown. Let them rest for 1–2 minutes, then soak them in the warm sugar syrup for at least 4 hours before serving.

साखर आणि पाणी उकळून साखर पूर्णपणे विरघळू द्या. त्यात वेलची पूड, केशर, गुलाबजल आणि गुलाबाच्या पाकळ्या घाला. गॅस बंद करून पाक कोमट ठेवून द्या. इलेक्ट्रिक चॉपरमध्ये मावा/खवा, मैदा आणि बेकिंग पावडर घालून दोन वेळा Pulse करा. मिश्रण कोरडे वाटत असेल किंवा एकजीव होत नसेल तर १ टीस्पून दूध घालून पुन्हा दोन वेळा Pulse करा. गरज असल्यास आणखी १ टीस्पून दूध घाला. मिश्रण बाहेर काढून १–२ मिनिटे हलक्या हाताने मळून मऊ, गुळगुळीत गोळा तयार करा. गोळा जास्त मळू नका. झाकून १० मिनिटे विश्रांती द्या.समान आकाराचे, भेगा नसलेले गोळे तयार करून मंद ते मध्यम-मंद आचेवर ८–१० मिनिटे सोनेरी-तपकिरी होईपर्यंत तळा. तळलेले गुलाबजाम १–२ मिनिटे थंड होऊ द्या, नंतर कोमट पाकात घालून किमान ४ तास भिजू द्या.

Prasika Tips: -

- Cream the mawa/khoya well for soft, melt-in-the-mouth gulab jamuns.
- If the dough cracks while shaping, add ½–1 tsp milk.
- Fry on low to medium-low heat for evenly cooked, golden brown gulab jamuns.
- Warm gulab jamuns + warm sugar syrup = perfect absorption.

Note:

- No electric chopper? Grate the mawa /Khoya (if it's firm) and cream it with the base of your palm for 10–15 minutes, until it's smooth, grain-free and starts leaving the plate. Then add the maida and baking powder.
- An electric chopper saves time by creaming the mawa/khoya in just 1–2 minutes, giving you a smooth, crack-free dough with minimal kneading.

title: India Will ‘NEVER’ Give MANGOES To Other Countries! Know Why! #shorts
description:
World Wants Indian Mangoes, But India Exports Less Than 1% of Its Crop

India grows more mangoes than any other country in the world, producing nearly 40% of the global supply. Yet, despite strong international demand, less than 1% of India's total mango production is exported—a statistic that has surprised consumers and trade experts across several countries. The issue has gained renewed attention after discussions around India's export potential and a successful sea shipment of Uttar Pradesh's Dashehari and Langra mangoes to Dubai highlighted the gap between production and exports.

Many countries are eager to import premium Indian varieties such as Alphonso, Kesar, Dashehari, Langra and Chausa. However, most of India's mango harvest is consumed domestically, where demand remains exceptionally high. In addition, exporters face challenges such as strict international quality standards, limited irradiation and treatment facilities, logistics costs and short shelf life, all of which restrict exports. As a result, countries that produce far fewer mangoes, including Mexico, Peru and Brazil, export significantly larger volumes in several international markets.

The discussion has intensified as India records another strong export season, with shipments reaching more than 45 countries and demand rising in markets such as the United States and the Middle East. APEDA and exporters are working to expand overseas sales through improved logistics, new shipping routes and market access. Experts believe that if infrastructure and export facilities improve, India could substantially increase its share of the global mango trade while giving farmers access to better international prices.

The revelation that the world's largest mango producer exports only a tiny fraction of its harvest has sparked widespread debate online, with many calling it one of India's biggest untapped agricultural opportunities.

title: OMG! Worst Smartphone Sales in 13 Years! Chip Shortage is Real Bro!! #shorts
description:
Smartphone Sales Crash to 13-Year Low as Global Demand Slumps

The global smartphone industry has recorded its weakest second quarter in 13 years, marking a major slowdown for one of the world's largest consumer electronics markets. According to new estimates from Counterpoint Research, worldwide smartphone shipments fell 11% year-on-year in the April-June quarter, dropping to their lowest Q2 level since 2013.

Analysts say the biggest reason behind the slump is the ongoing global memory chip shortage. The rapid expansion of AI data centres has sharply increased demand for DRAM and NAND memory chips, pushing up component costs for smartphone manufacturers. Most brands have passed these higher costs on to consumers through price increases, reducing demand for new devices.

The slowdown has affected nearly every major smartphone maker. While premium brands such as Apple and Samsung have managed to hold on to market share, many Android manufacturers have faced weaker sales as buyers postpone upgrades or opt for lower-priced models. Industry experts say consumers are now keeping their smartphones for longer instead of replacing them every two or three years.

The outlook for the rest of 2026 also remains challenging. IDC now expects global smartphone shipments to fall by nearly 14% this year, making it the steepest annual decline on record unless memory supplies improve and component prices stabilise. Manufacturers are increasingly focusing on premium AI-powered devices to protect profits, even as the broader market continues to weaken.
